title: Online Anxiety & Depression Therapy UK | Therapy with Roy | Roy Lam MBACP
description: Online therapy for anxiety and depression with Roy Lam, MBACP. UK-based, available worldwide. English and Cantonese. Sessions £80. Free consultation.

hero.eyebrow: Online therapy for anxiety & depression · UK-based, available worldwide
hero.subtitle: A confidential, non-judgemental space to understand what you are feeling, ease the pressure and build the resilience to move forward.

problem.label: What you may be feeling
problem.title: When worry or low mood is taking over
paragraphs: Anxiety and low mood look different for everyone: constant worry, difficulty switching off, exhaustion, or a sense of being stuck while you keep performing on the outside. Reaching out is a courageous first step.

Many of my clients are navigating high-pressure professional lives alongside deeply personal challenges. I understand this from over 30 years working in Human Resources across banking, aviation, luxury retail and hospitality.
problem.quote:
“Without good mental health, it is very difficult
to thrive in life.”

steps.title: Free Consultation
steps.text: Book a free 15–30 minute call. We’ll talk about what’s brought you here and whether we’re a good fit. No commitment required.

steps.title: Begin Sessions
steps.text: We meet online via Google Meet, Monday to Friday, 9am–7pm London time. Sessions are 50 minutes, at your own pace.

steps.title: Reflect & Grow
steps.text: Over time, build greater self-awareness, emotional resilience and the tools to handle whatever life brings, with me alongside you every step of the way.

approach.title: Integrative and tailored to you
paragraphs: My approach is integrative and tailored to each individual. I draw on Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Emotion-Focused Therapy and Bowen’s Family Systems Theory, combining evidence-based techniques with a warm, genuinely non-judgemental presence.

I graduated with a Master in Social Sciences (Counselling) from the University of Hong Kong in 2017, and volunteered as a counsellor working with clients facing family difficulties, relationship challenges, LGBT-related concerns, depression, anxiety and career development issues.
I am a registered member of the BACP (No. 397064), and I offer sessions in both English and Cantonese.
